definition: a person born where their people always lived
description: A snowy reindeer corral at pink winter dawn. A young woman with long fair braids, a dark blue knitted hat with a red patterned band, a black snowsuit and fur-trimmed boots strides through the snow and pulls a large reindeer along by a rope lasso. Many more reindeer with big antlers crowd behind her inside a wooden fence. Behind them stand a cone-shaped canvas tent with a fire glowing inside, a snowmobile, a person in orange and a line of bare birch trees.

en.question: What is the young woman doing?

de.answer: Sie zieht ein Rentier durch den Schnee.
de.question: Was macht die junge Frau?

es.answer: Está arrastrando un reno por la nieve.
